_source: I-SAPS 'Reading Resources Level 1 (1).docx' (partner-supplied, Sept 2026). Items with url null are listed by I-SAPS as 'free resource not available'.

1.title: Changing Education Paradigms — TED Talk / RSA Animate (2010)
1.author: Sir Ken Robinson
1.description: A systemic critique of factory-model schooling and conventional approaches to education.

1.title: The New Meaning of Educational Change (5th ed., 2015)
1.author: Michael Fullan
1.description: Explores why meaningful educational transformation requires systemic thinking rather than isolated fixes at the individual teacher level.

1.title: Professional Capital (2012)
1.author: Andy Hargreaves and Michael Fullan
1.description: Argues for building teacher professional capacity within realistic system constraints.

2.title: The Beautiful Risk of Education (2013)
2.author: Gert Biesta
2.description: Explores the idea of subjectification: education as supporting students in developing voice, agency, and the capacity to think for themselves.

2.title: Emotional Intelligence (1995)
2.author: Daniel Goleman
2.description: A foundational reference on the role of emotional awareness and emotional safety in learning.

2.title: Good Education in an Age of Measurement (2010)
2.author: Gert Biesta
2.description: Chapter 3, “Participation, Play, and the Politics of Education,” provides a core reference for understanding meaningful participation in education.

2.title: Mindset (2006)
2.author: Carol Dweck
2.description: Introduces the distinction between fixed and growth mindsets and examines how beliefs about ability shape responses to student success and failure.

2.title: Those Who Understand: Knowledge Growth in Teaching (1986)
2.author: Lee Shulman
2.description: Introduces the concept of Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK), highlighting the importance of understanding how students engage with and respond to specific subject content.

2.title: Teaching Problems and the Problems of Teaching (2001)
2.author: Magdalene Lampert
2.description: Chapter 2 explores planning as a process of anticipating student thinking and responses in advance.

2.title: Visible Learning (2009)
2.author: John Hattie
2.description: A major synthesis of research on factors affecting student achievement, including classroom discussion and questioning.

2.title: Designing Groupwork: Strategies for the Heterogeneous Classroom (1994)
2.author: Elizabeth Cohen
2.description: Examines the importance of structured roles and participation in preventing a small number of students from dominating group work.

2.title: Embedded Formative Assessment (2011)
2.author: Dylan Wiliam
2.description: Chapter 4 focuses on classroom questioning strategies that help ensure all students participate in thinking and learning.

2.title: Structured Classroom Management Research (2022)
2.author: Wilkins
2.description: Explores pre-emptive participation design and the role of clear expectations in increasing classroom engagement.

2.title: Tools for Teaching (2007)
2.author: Fred Jones
2.description: Focuses on proactive classroom management through the organisation of the physical environment, establishment of routines, and structured participation.

2.title: “Grit: The Power of Passion and Perseverance” — TED Talk (2013)
2.author: Angela Duckworth
2.description: Explores the role of persistence and the conditions that shape sustained effort.

2.title: “Let's Teach for Mastery — Not Test Scores” — TED Talk (2015)
2.author: Sal Khan
2.description: Challenges assumptions about student ability and argues for mastery-oriented learning.

2.title: “3 Rules to Spark Learning” — TED Talk (2013)
2.author: Ramsey Musallam
2.description: Presents an approach centred on creating curiosity and questions before direct instruction.

2.title: “5 Principles of Extraordinary Math Teaching” (2016)
2.author: Dan Finkel
2.description: Explores questioning approaches designed to ensure that all students think and participate.

2.title: “Cold Call” Technique
2.author: Doug Lemov
2.description: Demonstrates a structured approach to whole-class participation.

2.title: Sara's Grade 10 Factorization Lesson
2.author: Sara
2.description: Included in full in the storyboard table, this lesson demonstrates FBISE-aligned, SLO-based planning for Mathematics.

3.title: Discipline and Group Management in Classrooms (1970)
3.author: Jacob Kounin
3.description: A foundational text on classroom management, emphasising withitness, momentum, and smoothness rather than reactive discipline.

3.title: Promoting Inclusive Education Through Kounin's Theory: A Pathway to Achieving SDG 4
3.author: Shalini Gupta and Harikrishnan M
3.description: Reviews how Kounin’s classroom-management concepts can support inclusive education and engagement.

3.title: Classroom Management That Works (2003)
3.author: Robert Marzano
3.description: A research synthesis examining effective classroom management strategies and their impact.

3.title: Classroom Management That Works (2003), Chapter 4
3.author: Robert Marzano, Jana Marzano, and Debra Pickering
3.description: Examines teacher–student relationships as a major factor in effective classroom management.

3.title: Conscious Classroom Management (2004)
3.author: Rick Smith
3.description: Provides practical strategies for relationship-building and the use of “I” language in classroom interactions.

3.title: “Teaching: The Greatest Job in the World” — TEDx Talk (2015)
3.author: Joe Ruhl
3.description: Explores teacher burnout and the factors that can make classroom teaching energising or exhausting.

3.title: “Every Kid Needs a Champion” — TED Talk (2013)
3.author: Rita Pierson
3.description: A reflection on the importance of teacher–student relationships in effective education.

3.title: AERO Classroom Management Practice Guide: Planning for Classroom Management
3.author: Australian Education Research Organisation

3.title: NCTQ Classroom Management Framework: Research Rationale
3.author: National Council on Teacher Quality (NCTQ)
3.description: Research rationale for the NCTQ Classroom Management Framework.

3.title: The Art of Classroom Management: Theories, Practices, and Essentials for Effective Learning Environments
3.author: Atlantic International University
3.description: A literature/resource overview of classroom-management theories, practices, and effective learning environments.

3.title: Classroom Management: Creating and Maintaining Positive Learning Environments
3.author: Centre for Education Statistics and Evaluation (CESE), NSW Department of Education
3.description: Literature review on creating and maintaining positive learning environments through classroom management.

3.title: Dialogic Pedagogies: Defining and Analyzing Four Types of Dialogue in Education
3.author: Ben Kilby

3.title: Discipline and Social-Emotional Learning
3.author: School Culture and Climate Initiative
3.description: Resource on using dialogue to manage difficult conversations and support positive school culture and climate.

4.title: Teaching in a Digital Age (2019)
4.author: Tony Bates
4.description: A comprehensive open textbook. Chapter 1 distinguishes educational technology from technology in education.

4.title: Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge: A Framework for Teacher Knowledge (2006)
4.author: Punya Mishra and Matthew Koehler
4.description: The original paper introducing the TPACK framework.

4.title: Teaching in a Digital Age — Chapter 5
4.author: Tony Bates

4.title: “Let's Use Video to Reinvent Education” — TED Talk (2011)
4.author: Sal Khan
4.description: Explores how technology can transform learning when used intentionally rather than decoratively.

4.title: TPACK Explained
4.author: Matthew J. Koehler
4.description: A visual overview of the three knowledge domains within TPACK and their intersection.

4.title: Technology in Education: A Tool on Whose Terms
4.author: WISE On Air
4.description: A video resource exploring the role and implications of technology in education.

4.title: Distinguishing the Field of Educational Technology
4.author: Laura Czerniewicz
4.description: A discussion of educational technology as a distinct field and its scope.

4.title: TPACK Explained
TPACK Framework in Education and for Teachers: Technology Integration
4.author: Matthew J. Koehler and Punya Mishra

4.title: Learning Theory and Online Technologies
4.author: Linda Harasim
4.description: Provides an overview of learning theory and online technologies, tracing the development of online learning and distinguishing major approaches to online learning.

4.title: A Review of Self-Regulated Learning: Six Models and Four Directions for Research
4.author: Ernesto Panadero
4.description: Reviews six major models of self-regulated learning and directions for future research.

4.title: SpringerBriefs 2023 — Chapter 2
Learning Theories: A Conceptual Framework for Learning and Instruction in Technology Education
What Do We Mean by Quality When Teaching in a Digital Age?
4.author: Tony Bates
4.description: Clarifies what “quality” means in teaching and learning in a digital age.

4.title: Chapter 11: Ensuring Quality Teaching in a Digital Age
4.author: Tony Bates
4.description: Chapter 11 of Teaching in a Digital Age, bringing together practical principles for quality teaching in a digital age.

4.title: Clarifying Misconceptions between Technology Education and Educational Technology
4.author: William E. Dugger

4.title: Evolution of Educational Technology: Technology of Education and Technology in Education
Design Ed: Connecting Learning Science Research to Practice
4.author: Angela Elkordy
4.description: Chapter 2 discusses theories and implications of learning in the digital age

4.title: “Review of the Concept “Self-Regulated Learning”: Defined and Used in Different Educational Contexts”
4.author: Merja Sinkkonen

4.title: 9. Quality
4.author: Commonwealth of Learning

5.title: An Introduction to Assessment: The Basics
5.author: College Level One (CL-1) Team
5.description: An introduction to classroom assessment, emphasizing assessment as a means of understanding and improving student learning.

5.title: Introduction to Assessment
5.author: Kingsborough Community College
5.description: Introduces the basic purposes, concepts, and processes of assessment.

5.title: Defining Assessment
5.author: University of Michigan, Center for Research on Learning and Teaching
5.description: Defines assessment and distinguishes formative, summative, and authentic assessment approaches.

5.title: Core Concepts in Assessment
5.author: Schools2030 / Oxford MeasurEd
5.description: Introduces core concepts in learning assessment, including purpose, validity, reliability, standardisation, constructs, bias, and fairness.

5.title: 10 Effective Assessment Methods Every Teacher Should Use
The Assessment Cycle
5.author: Cox Campus
5.description: Presents assessment as a continuous cycle linking learning goals, instruction, evidence, reflection, and adjustment.

5.title: The Assessment Cycle Step-by-Step
5.author: University of West Florida
5.description: Step-by-step guide to identifying learning outcomes, selecting assessment methods, collecting evidence, and using results.

5.title: Formative Assessments: Using Feedback to Guide Instruction
5.author: SanBdoCitySchools
5.description: Video showing how formative assessment and feedback can guide instructional decisions.

5.title: Formative Assessment and Good Feedback
5.author: Oxford University Centre for Educational Assessment
5.description: Video discussion of formative assessment and effective feedback.

5.title: Formative Assessment: Practical Ideas for Improving the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Feedback to Students
5.author: Geraldine O’Neill
5.description: Practical guide to improving the efficiency and effectiveness of formative feedback to students.

5.title: Triangulating Data for Instructional Insights
5.author: NWEA
5.description: Workbook on using multiple sources of evidence to develop instructional insights and plan next steps.

5.title: Data Triangulation for Measuring SEL
5.author: Teach For All
5.description: Resource on triangulating multiple data sources to measure social-emotional learning.

5.title: Standards for Teacher Competence in Educational Assessment
5.author: American Federation of Teachers, NCME, and NEA
5.description: Standards describing core competencies teachers need for educational assessment of students.

6.title: The Beautiful Risk of Education (2013)
6.author: Gert Biesta
6.description: Explores the three functions of education: qualification, socialisation, and subjectification, with particular attention to the development of independent and thinking selves.

6.title: “The Linguistic Genius of Babies” — TED Talk (2010)
6.author: Patricia Kuhl
6.description: Explores how expectations and environments shape cognitive development.

6.title: Active Learning
6.author: Edutopia
6.description: A video resource on active learning approaches.

6.title: Learner-Centered Classroom
6.author: Sociology Burger
6.description: A video resource exploring learner-centred teaching and learning.

7.title: Teachers Who Dare Teach — Pedagogy of Hope (1994)
7.author: Paulo Freire
7.description: Explores qualities and virtues associated with teaching, including humility, tolerance, decisiveness, and joy.

7.title: The Global Achievement Gap (2008)

7.description: Introduces the Seven Survival Skills, including critical thinking, collaboration, and effective communication, which inform the 5Cs framework.

7.author: John Larmer and John Mergendoller

7.author: Sharon Feiman-Nemser

7.title: Teaching for Quality Learning (2003)
7.author: John Biggs
7.description: Explores Constructive Alignment, emphasising the alignment of learning objectives, teaching and learning activities, and assessment.

7.title: Taxonomy of Educational Objectives (1956/2001)
7.author: Benjamin Bloom
7.description: Explores the cognitive domain and the use of different verbs to represent varying levels of thinking.

7.title: “Creating Innovators” — Google Talk (2012)
7.author: Tony Wagner
7.description: Explores why twenty-first-century skills should move beyond knowledge transmission as a central goal of schooling.

7.title: “The Thoughtful Classroom: Prioritize Deep Understanding”
7.author: Grant Wiggins
7.description: A recorded lecture exploring the importance of beginning instructional design with desired understanding.

7.title: Every Drop Counts
7.description: An interdisciplinary project linking a Science SLO on water quality with a Mathematics SLO on data and graphs. The full project plan is included in the storyboard table.

7.title: Grant Wiggins - Understanding by Design (2 of 2)
7.author: Avenues The World School
7.description: Educator Grant Wiggins leads a workshop at Avenues on Understanding by design (UbD), a framework for improving student achievement that helps teachers clarify learning goals, devise assessments that reveal student understanding, and craft effective learning activities.

8.title: Teach Like a Champion 3.0: 63 Techniques That Put Students on the Path to College
8.author: Doug Lemov
8.description: A practical guide to classroom teaching techniques for engagement, expectations, checking for understanding, discussion, writing, behaviour, and learning.

8.title: The Lazy Teacher’s Handbook – New Edition
8.author: Jim Smith
8.description: Practical strategies for shifting more of the work of learning to students while making teaching more efficient and sustainable.

8.title: Strange Pictures
8.author: Uketsu
8.description: A mystery novel built around a series of unsettling drawings whose clues gradually reveal a connected story.

9.title: Leaders Mentoring Others: The Effects of Implicit Followership Theory on Leader Integrity and Mentoring
9.author: Jeffrey Yip and Dayna O. H. Walker
9.description: Examines how leaders’ assumptions about followers relate to leader integrity, engagement, and mentoring effectiveness.

9.title: The Mentor Leader: Secrets to Building People and Teams That Win Consistently
9.author: Tony Dungy and Nathan Whitaker
9.description: Presents a mentoring-oriented leadership approach focused on developing people and teams.

9.title: Leadership Tips for Principals, Educators and School Leaders: How to Lead Schools in a Changing World
How to Break Through Fear and Become a Leader
9.author: Valerie Montgomery Rice
9.description: TED Talk on vigilance, grit, resilience, overcoming fear, and leadership.

9.title: Effective Mentoring: A Resource and Guide for Mentors
9.author: Ian Phillips, Ajay Bundy, and Jackee Holder
9.description: A practical guide for formal and informal mentors, including mentoring relationships, rapport, questioning, reflection, and inclusive mentoring.

9.title: Professional Learning and Collaboration for Teachers
9.author: Education Resource Strategies (ERS)
9.description: Guide to building sustainable professional learning and collaboration structures for educators.

9.title: The Key to Powerful Leadership Communication
9.author: Gregg Thompson / Bluepoint Leadership Development
9.description: Explores the difference between management communication and leadership communication and offers three dimensions for powerful leadership communication.

9.title: A Leadership Coach's Guide to Communication in the Workplace — Linnita Hosten
9.author: Linnita Hosten
9.description: TEDx talk on communication in the workplace, drawing on psychology, linguistics, emotional intelligence, and behavioural science.

9.title: The Power of Teacher Leadership to Build Collaboration
9.author: Pearly V. Villagracia
9.description: Discusses teacher leadership as a means of building collaboration, trust, professional learning, and school improvement.

9.title: Teacher Leader Model Standards
9.author: Teacher Leadership Exploratory Consortium
9.description: Standards describing seven domains of teacher leadership, including collaboration, professional learning, assessment/data use, and advocacy.
